description: Land Acquisition - Godunna, Kandaketiya D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act announcing the government's intention to acquire specific land lots for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of 27 land parcels including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, extents, and boundary information. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
